reauth.title: Your access changed — sign in again
reauth.body: Your roles or security settings changed since you signed in. Sign in again to use your current access.

errors.messaging_blocked: Messaging is not available here: one of you has blocked the other.
errors.rate_limited: You are sending messages too quickly. Try again later.
errors.html_not_allowed: Messages must be plain text; HTML markup is not allowed.
errors.already_reported: You have already reported this message.
errors.invalid_report: You cannot report your own message.
errors.cannot_reset_own_mfa: You cannot reset your own two-factor authentication; use your recovery codes.
errors.mfa_not_enabled: This user has no two-factor authentication to reset.
errors.completion_awards_disabled: This course does not issue completion awards.
errors.not_enrolled: You are not enrolled in this course.
errors.course_not_completed: Complete every lesson of the course first.
errors.certificate_not_public: Make this certificate public before sharing it on LinkedIn.
errors.verify_url_not_configured: Sharing is not available yet: the public verification address has not been configured.
errors.not_checked: Check the answer first (self-grading closes when the session is finished).
errors.attempt_in_progress: Questions can be bookmarked after the exam is submitted.
errors.regrade_decided: This regrade was already decided; there is nothing to preview.
errors.invalid_state: This video is still in the upload pipeline and cannot be marked.
errors.use_confirm: Use reviewer confirmation to mark a video Ready.

msg.inboxSubtitle: Private conversations between learners and the instructors of courses they are enrolled in.
msg.emptyBody: Enrolled learners can message a course's instructors from the course page.
msg.privacy: Only you, the course's instructors and moderators can read this conversation.

invalid.tooLong: Messages can be at most {max} characters.
invalid.html: Remove HTML markup; messages are plain text.

msg.instructorHelp: Your message goes to the instructors of this course. Replies appear in Messages.
msg.notEnrolled: This person is not enrolled in the course, so they cannot be messaged.
msg.hiddenBody: This message was hidden by a moderator.
msg.reportHelp: A report goes to the Trust & Safety team with the message text. The sender is not told who reported it.
msg.reportReason: What is wrong with this message?
msg.blockBody: They will no longer be able to message you, and automatic messages from them are skipped. You can unblock them from Messages.

mod.title: Reported messages
mod.subtitle: Messages reported by participants. Hiding keeps the message for moderators and shows participants the reason.

auto.title: Automatic messages
auto.welcomeHelp: Sent once to each learner who enrolls after you switch it on (existing learners are not messaged).
auto.completionHelp: Sent once when a learner completes every lesson of the published course.
auto.enabledHint: Switching on applies to enrollments or completions from now on.

studio.noConversations: No learner has messaged this course yet.
studio.messageLearnerHow: To start a conversation, use “Message learner” on a learner's discussion thread; the learner must be enrolled.

cred.assessedNote: Issued for passing a server-scored assessment.
cred.completionNote: Attests that every lesson was completed. It does not certify assessed knowledge.
cred.studioHelp: Learners who complete every lesson get a Certificate of Completion. It is clearly labelled as attesting lesson completion, not assessed knowledge.
cred.studioToggle: Issue completion awards for this course

sg.legend: How well did you remember this?
sg.help: Your rating sets when this question comes back for review.
sg.q1: Wrong, but I recognised the answer

neg.title: Negative marking
neg.rule: Each wrong answer deducts {rate} of a point from your total.
neg.unanswered: Unanswered questions are never penalised, and your total never goes below zero.
neg.resultDeduction: {n} wrong answer(s) cost up to {points} point(s).

regrade.title: Preview before approving
regrade.help: A dry run with the proposed key. Nothing is changed until you approve.

mfa.title: Reset two-factor authentication for {name}
mfa.explain: This removes their authenticator and recovery codes, signs them out everywhere and requires them to set up two-factor authentication again at their next sign-in. They are notified.
mfa.fresh: For safety you must have signed in with two-factor authentication within the last 10 minutes.
mfa.reauthBody: Sign in again with your authenticator code, then retry the reset.

video.title: Mark {title}
video.help: Use when a video is unavailable (restricted or failed) and needs attention. Ready can only be set by reviewer confirmation.

ai.title: AI usage
ai.none: No AI usage in this range.
ai.estimate: Costs are estimates from token counts.

support.title: Support console
support.subtitle: Read-only account lookup. Emails and payment ids are masked.
support.pickUser: Search for a user to see their account

picker.userHint: Name, email prefix, exact email or user id.
picker.assessmentHint: Assessment title, course title or code, or an exact id.
picker.noImages: This course has no non-premium image resources.
picker.assessmentOptional: Assessment (optional; leave empty for every assessment)

hiddenPost.title: Your post was hidden by a moderator
hiddenPost.onlyYou: Only you can see this post. If you think this was a mistake, you can appeal.

cal.title: Calendar subscription
cal.help: Subscribe from your calendar app to see your study sessions update automatically. Anyone with the link can see your plan, so keep it private.
cal.shownOnce: The link is shown only when created. Creating a new one stops the old link.
cal.urlHint: Copy this into your calendar app's “subscribe to calendar” option.
cal.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the link and copy it manually.
cal.revokeBody: Calendars subscribed with this link stop updating.

tz.hint: Local time in {zone} (your profile time zone).
